title: sorbus aria subsp. carpinifolia
intro: Sorbus aria subsp. carpinifolia, commonly known as the Mountain Ash, is a subspecies of the whitebeam tree, characterized by its distinctive white flowers and red berries. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus aria subsp. carpinifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
